actual_request.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the sprite to advance by one small walking step. Image2 is authoritative original identity, Image3 the confirmed main painting style. Preserve full upper body, face, brown twin buns and long twin tails, red-white-gold costume, same red-gold boots and two-hand grip of complete straight dark-shaft spear. Preserve the southwest-facing camera (toward lower left). Change only the gait: screen-left boot remains flat and load bearing; screen-right boot is airborne and tucked closer underneath the pelvis, advancing from its rear position in image1 toward the planted leg, with knee bent mildly and toes hanging downward. This is the step just before both knees pass. Near anatomical LEFT thigh is the foreground thigh; far anatomical RIGHT leg is planted. Do not lift the planted foot, do not exchange clothing or camera. Full-body single sprite native at least 1024 by 1024 on genuine transparent alpha. Allow generous empty margin around complete spear and toes. Remove isolated colored specks and colored matte fringing outside the silhouette. No floor, shadow, words or sheet.
